intro.fallback: Naruto, Hinata, and Kiba accept what they believe will be an very easy mission to catch a criminal.
Upon arriving at the thief's last known location however, they learn that another bounty hunter, Sazanami, is pursuing the thief and also that he is a skilled swordsman.
Sazanami is later wounded in the battle and Naruto's group takes him to safety, but discover that he too is a wanted criminal when a bounty hunter tried to catch him.
